records.title: The incoming batch
records.question: How many runs are loaded?
records.guide: The artificial runs are already loaded. Check the run count.

records.title: Inspect the loaded file
records.question: Open the highlighted evidence, then confirm.
records.guide: Open File integrity to see the files used in this game.

records.title: Find the repeat findings
records.question: How many target groups have outcome Repeat?
records.guide: Inspect the target results. These findings are computed by the active training profile.

records.title: One group needs a repeat
records.question: What does the active profile say?
records.guide: Follow the highlighted sample and read its outcome.

records.title: The negative control has a signal
records.question: Which finding is recorded?
records.guide: Inspect the failed control. A signal is not a supported explanation of its cause.

records.title: Do not guess the cause
records.question: Choose the supported statement.
records.guide: The same control has a signal. What can you conclude from this evidence alone?

records.title: The final-cycle tokens
records.question: How many rows are cycle-limit tokens?
records.guide: The extra RDML run is loaded in MISSY. Its rows retain the reader's cycle-limit classification.

records.title: Same cycle, different evidence
records.question: How many measured Cq values remain at cycle 40?
records.guide: Two rows retain finite Cq values with supplied analysis evidence; the other rows do not.

records.title: Select the token
records.question: Select well A1, then confirm.
records.guide: Use Quality & forensic review → Plate map. Select well A1, or type Computer, select well A1.

records.title: No limits yet
records.question: Can this chart establish an in-control status?
records.guide: The short instrument history has too few runs. Look at its actual chart.

records.title: Count the short history
records.question: How many points are in this instrument history?
records.guide: Count the plotted history points, not the number of samples.

records.title: Compare the right instrument
records.question: How many points are in the primary background chart?
records.guide: The main and short histories are separate. Use the primary instrument.

records.title: Find the flagged history
records.question: How many points carry recorded flags?
records.guide: Inspect the background chart. Count recorded flags; do not diagnose hardware failure.

records.title: Select a flagged point
records.question: Select the first flagged point.
records.guide: Click one highlighted point in the real MISSY chart.

records.title: Wells are not result rows
records.question: How many distinct well positions are occupied in run one?
records.guide: One well can hold two target result rows. Count distinct occupied positions.

records.title: Inspect amplification
records.question: Open the highlighted evidence, then confirm.
records.guide: Open the amplification graph. Mouse, keyboard and voice can navigate the same data.

records.title: Read stored melt values
records.question: How many stored melting result rows are in run one?
records.guide: Use Load files and inspect the Tm results column in the normal loaded-experiments table. These are stored results, not newly identified peaks.

records.title: Inspect the standards
records.question: How many distinct standard wells are in run one?
records.guide: Standards have a role and a declared concentration. Do not treat a role label as a measured quantity.

records.title: Outside the method scope
records.question: What does applicability say?
records.guide: The training profile now requires a different run-name pattern. The acquired results are unchanged.

answer.call: Stop and obtain a verified copy

truth.call: Stop and obtain a verified copy
Stop and obtain a verified copy

records.displayAnswer: Stop and obtain a verified copy
records.displayTruth: Stop and obtain a verified copy
records.title: A changed evidence copy
records.question: What is the safe next action?
records.guide: The case manifest compares a trusted digest with a changed-copy digest. This is a training exhibit, not a vendor checksum failure claim.

records.title: A checksum was not supplied
records.question: What does the absence establish?
records.guide: The exhibit has no expected checksum. An absent comparison is not a failed comparison.

records.title: Review before exporting
records.question: Open the highlighted evidence, then confirm.
records.guide: Inspect the report workspace before sharing. No report is released automatically.

records.title: Prepare the training report
records.question: Build the report, then confirm.
records.guide: Build a real PDF from the artificial data. This stays in the training workspace.

records.title: A finding is not authorisation
records.question: Who may authorise release?
records.guide: Finish the review by stating who authorises laboratory release.

records.title: 收到的文件
records.question: 已加载多少个运行？
records.guide: 模拟运行已加载。请查看运行数量。

records.title: 查看已加载文件
records.question: 打开高亮证据，然后确认。
records.guide: 打开文件完整性页面，查看本游戏使用的文件。

records.title: 查找复测判定
records.question: 有多少个靶标组被判定为复测？
records.guide: 查看靶标结果。这些判定由当前训练配置计算。

records.title: 一个组需要复测
records.question: 当前配置给出什么判定？
records.guide: 查看高亮样品及其判定。

records.title: 阴性对照出现信号
records.question: 记录了哪项判定？
records.guide: 检查失败的对照。信号不能直接证明其原因。

records.displayAnswer: 仅能描述观察，需要进一步调查
records.displayTruth: 仅能描述观察，需要进一步调查
records.title: 不要猜测原因
records.question: 选择有证据支持的陈述。
records.guide: 同一对照出现信号。仅凭这些证据能得出什么结论？

records.title: 最后循环的标记
records.question: 有多少条记录属于循环上限标记？
records.guide: 附加RDML运行已加载。记录保留了读取器对循环上限标记的分类。

records.title: 相同循环，不同证据
records.question: 第40循环保留了多少个实测Cq？
records.guide: 两条记录保留有限Cq及所提供的分析证据，其余记录没有。

records.title: 选择标记记录
records.question: 选择A1孔，然后确认。
records.guide: 进入质量与取证审核，再进入孔板布局。选择A1孔，也可输入命令选择。

records.title: 尚无控制限
records.question: 该图能否确定受控状态？
records.guide: 该仪器历史运行数量不足。请查看实际图表。

records.title: 统计短历史记录
records.question: 该仪器历史有多少个点？
records.guide: 统计图中的历史点，不是样品数。

records.title: 比较正确的仪器
records.question: 主仪器背景图有多少个点？
records.guide: 主仪器与短历史仪器分开显示。请查看主仪器。

records.title: 查找有标记的历史
records.question: 有多少个点带有记录标记？
records.guide: 查看背景图。统计记录标记，不要直接诊断硬件故障。

records.title: 选择有标记的点
records.question: 选择第一个有标记的点。
records.guide: 点击MISSY实际图表中的一个高亮点。

records.title: 孔位与结果行不同
records.question: 第一个运行占用了多少个不同孔位？
records.guide: 同一孔可有两个靶标结果行。请统计不同的占用孔位。

records.title: 查看扩增曲线
records.question: 打开高亮证据，然后确认。
records.guide: 打开扩增图。鼠标、键盘和语音可查看同一数据。

records.title: 读取存储熔解值
records.question: 第一个运行有多少条存储熔解结果？
records.guide: 进入加载文件，查看已加载实验表中的Tm结果列。这些是存储结果，不是新识别的峰。

records.title: 查看标准品
records.question: 第一个运行有多少个不同的标准品孔？
records.guide: 标准品有角色及声明浓度。不要把角色标签当作测量数量。

records.title: 超出方法范围
records.question: 适用性给出什么结果？
records.guide: 训练配置现要求不同的运行名称模式，采集结果未变。

answer.call: Stop and obtain a verified copy

truth.call: Stop and obtain a verified copy
Stop and obtain a verified copy

records.displayAnswer: 停止并获取经核实的副本
records.displayTruth: 停止并获取经核实的副本
records.title: 证据副本发生变化
records.question: 安全的下一步是什么？
records.guide: 案例清单比较可信摘要与已更改副本的摘要。这是训练证据，不是对厂商校验失败的声明。

records.title: 未提供校验值
records.question: 缺失校验值能说明什么？
records.guide: 证据没有预期校验值。无法比较不等于比较失败。

records.title: 导出前审核
records.question: 打开高亮证据，然后确认。
records.guide: 分享前检查报告工作区。系统不会自动签发报告。

records.title: 准备训练报告
records.question: 生成报告，然后确认。
records.guide: 使用模拟数据生成真实PDF，文件保留在训练工作区。

records.title: 判定不等于授权
records.question: 由谁授权签发？
records.guide: 完成审核，说明由谁授权签发实验室结果。
